# laravelforge_server_php_version (Data Source)

Fetches a single PHP version installed on a Laravel Forge server by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the installed PHP version.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the PHP version is installed on.

### Read-Only

- `binary_name` (String) PHP binary name (e.g. `php82`).
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `status` (String) Installation status.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `version` (String) PHP version key (e.g. `php82`).
